title: A priori error estimator for reduced-order models based on the higher-order Craig-Bampton method in dynamic substructuring
summary: The higher-order Craig-Bampton (HCB) method improves reduced-model accuracy through successive residual-mode enrichments. This study proposes an a priori estimator for the eigenvalue error remaining in the first-order HCB model (HCB-1) without using the full-order eigensolution. The estimator is defined as the relative difference between the HCB-1 and HCB-2 eigenvalues.
